name: Escaping Ban'ethil

angles.text: Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom is a sister-in-arms. Her capture beneath the roots cuts against the night elves' sacred bond with Teldrassil's open stars and canopy.
Ban'ethil Barrow Den is meant as a sanctuary where druids sleep and commune with the Emerald Dream. Its fall to feral furbolg makes this an urgent crisis for Cenarion protectors.
To safeguard Darnassus and Teldrassil, you aid the Sentinels against growing hostility from corrupted native wildlife and tribes.

aliases: who is trapped in the barrow den
faq.answer: Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom is a night elf sentinel on Teldrassil. The Oracle Tree sent her to carry a message to the druids resting in Ban'ethil Barrow Den, where Gnarlpine furbolg captured her.

aliases: why did lynessa go to banethil
faq.answer: The Oracle Tree sent Lynessa to carry a message to the druids sleeping in Ban'ethil Barrow Den. But hostile furbolg had overrun the underground den, and she could not deliver it.
faq.q: Why did Sentinel Lynessa enter Ban'ethil Barrow Den?

faq.answer: Gnarlpine furbolg captured Lynessa in the barrow den. They ambushed her before she could escape and dragged her into the depths. There, she feared they would make her their next meal.
Ban'ethil Barrow Den lies underground on Teldrassil, west of Dolanaar. Night elf druids traditionally rest there in deep communion, but corrupt Gnarlpine furbolg have overrun it.

aliases: where do i turn in escaping banethil
faq.answer: Sentinel Kyra Starsong is a night elf sentinel posted in Dolanaar. A close friend of Lynessa Duskblossom, she awaits news that Lynessa has escaped and reached safety.

aliases: why do night elves dislike barrow dens
under the earth is no place for kaldorei
faq.answer: Many night elf Sentinels and warriors dislike being trapped underground, though druids use barrow dens for sacred slumber. Kaldorei culture cherishes the open night sky, Elune's starlight, and the forest canopy above subterranean tunnels.
faq.q: Why does Lynessa loathe being underground?

sections.body: Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom entered Ban'ethil Barrow Den on the Oracle Tree's orders. She carried a message to the druids resting there. But aggressive Gnarlpine furbolg had overrun the tunnels and ambushed her before she could retreat. They took her prisoner, and Lynessa feared the tribe would kill her. Now you can fight your way with her back to the surface.
sections.title: Ambushed Beneath the Roots

sections.body: For the kaldorei Sentinels, the gloom of a barrow den is hard to endure. It leaves them far from Elune's starlight and Teldrassil's open air. After her rescue, Lynessa makes her way back toward civilization, while word of her survival reaches Dolanaar. Sentinel Kyra Starsong, Lynessa's friend, receives the news with relief. Those who help Lynessa defend the kaldorei people earn Kyra's thanks.
sections.title: Safe Return to Dolanaar

summary: Beneath Teldrassil, Sentinel Lynessa Duskblossom is trapped in Ban'ethil Barrow Den. Gnarlpine furbolg seized her while she carried a message to the slumbering druids. She needs to reach the surface so Dolanaar can hear she is safe.
